title: Roswell crash as exotic human technology
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Roswell crash as exotic human technology, about 1947 at Roswell, New Mexico, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think yeah I think it's a possibility that what crashed in Roswell was was human technology.

related.note: The same 1947 Roswell crash, but this telling says the craft may have been human technology, while the story's tellings call it a bona fide UFO crash.

plain: A writer and historian, Peter Levenda, says he thinks it possible that whatever crashed near Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947 was human technology rather than something from elsewhere, and he points to a book called Secret Machines. If true, it would mean people were building strange, advanced craft far earlier than anyone admits.
